item.title: TKO stocks surge to new all-time high following Q4 and FY 2025 results
item.description: TKO stocks reached new all-time high today following a successful Q4 and FY 2025 earnings results, closing the trading day at $223.81. Stocks traded slightly lower after hours, losing around 1.2% from the closing number.
